pathRules: Reject ambiguous Work Unit IDs and mismatched repositories.
Do not persist credentials, tokens or unnecessary prompt bodies.
Worktree mode excludes the entire .agent-factory directory.
permissions: Use the launch context established by the one-time sufficiency check.
Do not introduce approval prompts during continuation.
Do not broaden sandbox, repository scope or execution mode during recovery.

content.queryContract: Canonical Work Unit JSON links Goal execution, progress, recovery and registered result evidence without Git snapshot identity.
redactionRules: Store bounded summaries and registered evidence only when required.

cases: insufficient Work Unit before launch -> refuse without Goal or worktree
specification-direct launch -> no worktree and primary specification.py mutation
turn interrupted -> automatic continuation in same Goal
Goal blocked by stale removed gate -> reactivate and continue
recovery limit exhausted -> explicit failure without hang
Human complete -> automatic integration and later batch cleanup

content.promotionRule: AI review and Human result review precede complete; complete automatically integrates worktree mode.
currentSpecificationGates: No approval, artifact checkpoint, immutable hash or Git HEAD identity contract
Explicit specification-direct and worktree execution routes
Interrupted and stale blocked Goal continuation contract
implementationGates: automatic integration and batch cleanup test
